state.context: The todo app is supposed to renew permitted owner evidence whenever a source changes, a business action completes or a user-selected period elapses. Its present refresh scenario sends work and records a correlated view; the current page timer only requests its representation. Under the normative page rule a timed GET cannot mutate records, issue external calls or schedule jobs. No WorkSources provider implementation exists. Maintenance, accounts, onboarding, board and volunteering must supply their own guarded list and detail reads rather than a synthesized adapter inventing visibility. Identity strings cannot impersonate a user. Any delegation needs an authenticated subject, team, target audience, grant revalidation and finite validity; forwarding the browser token is disallowed. Canonical action handles still require authenticated provenance plus sealed versioned record arguments. The alternatives retain all those restrictions and existing operation authority; this is source design work only. Compare practical source economy and adoption with the real implementation obligations; probability is advisory.

freshness_owner.instructions: Select the smallest defensible owner for the required automatic evidence renewal among these competing contracts.

criteria.adapter: Have WorkSources accept a limited-duration subscription using the existing capability boundary. A request names account, locations and refresh interval; the response identifies a watch, its validity deadline and sequence alongside initial WorkBatch. Verified change notifications include watch ID, newer sequence and a whole updated batch. Its installed provider rechecks delegated owner access on invalidations, successful business actions and periodic reads. The consumer matches delivery and watch revisions and removes expired/unavailable action handles. Fewer browser behaviors are needed, at the cost of service credentials, lease renewal and notification ordering rules.
criteria.session: Use the unchanged work capability from the existing authorized refresh operation. Specify one canonical UI automatic-submit behavior for action completion, verified source changes and the configured timer, enabled only within a current authenticated session. These submissions are POST invocations with current admission and retained location arguments, separate from read-only GET polling. It minimizes provider state while requiring browser lifecycle bounds, stale-request coordination, draft preservation and an authenticated invalidation channel; there is no unattended refresh after that session ends.
criteria.defer: Leave refresh as a manual canonical action and disclose that the automatic requirement is outstanding. This postpones choosing an underspecified service or browser mechanism while retaining existing permissions, but automatic freshness remains unavailable.

existing_automatic.instructions: Are all action-driven, change-driven and periodic owner reads already guaranteed by the shown source together with the read-only page timer rules?

criteria.true: The existing contracts guarantee the three automatic owner-read triggers with no additional declaration.
criteria.false: The source and timer specification leave at least one of the demanded automatic read triggers undefined.
